questions: Did oval progress hold at 0.95 or more with 20 of 20 finishes on the 50 mm, wheel_track 0.10 base? If it fell, what were kp, ki, kd and base_speed?
Did s-bend and slalom max_error move below 0.06 m with your controller? If not, do the excursions still start before a line-loss event?
Did steering_oscillation on the s-bend stay near 0.3 or below? If it was above 0.3, did you lower kp or kd to bring it down?
If bend max_error stays on the 0.06 m plateau with the controller tuned, would you accept a y 0.04 lead test on the bend tracks in the next iteration, with no other change?

intent: Revert to the iteration 7 geometry (50 mm span at 12.5 mm pitch, 12 mm footprints, y 0.05, wheel_track 0.10), which is the best raced design (399.7, oval progress 0.995). Iteration 8 showed that the 60 mm span drops oval progress to 0.301, and iteration 3 showed the same collapse, so 60 mm is rejected. The Integrator's controller is the only variable this race, so any change in bend behaviour can be attributed to it.
learning: Iteration 8 confirmed that span is non-monotonic: 40 mm gives oval progress 0.664, 50 mm gives 0.710 (0.995 with wheel_track 0.10), and 60 mm collapses to 0.275 or 0.301 at 12 mm. Bend max_error has stayed at 0.059 to 0.068 m across all span, footprint, lead, wheel_track and controller changes, so it is not yet explained by sensing geometry. The next untested geometry lever is the lead (y 0.04) on the bend tracks only, not further span changes.
rationale: Iteration 8 (60 mm span, 12 mm footprint, y 0.05, wheel_track 0.10) failed. Oval progress fell from 0.995 to 0.301, with all 20 oval runs leaving the track. Bend max_error moved only from 0.0676 to 0.0634 m on the s-bend and from 0.0608 to 0.0618 m on the slalom, and neither track finished. The span was the variable that changed, and the result matches iteration 3, where the same 60 mm span with 12 mm footprints also collapsed (oval 0.275). Two independent 60 mm runs have now dropped the oval, so the span is the cause, not the controller. Under the rule agreed in the Integrator's feedback, the span is reverted to 50 mm, and the 0.65 oval floor is the test. Oval steering oscillation was 0.24, below the 0.35 threshold, so this is not a gain-only failure. It is not worth keeping 60 mm on the evidence, because bend max_error is still on its 0.059 to 0.068 m plateau. I therefore return to the iteration 7 geometry exactly: x = -0.025, -0.0125, 0, 0.0125, 0.025, 12 mm footprints, y 0.05, wheel_track 0.10, and the same body, wheel and mass values. Iteration 7 is the best result so far (399.7, oval progress 0.995, 20 of 20 finishes). Bend max_error has not responded to any geometry change tried, so this design is kept as the robust base. Expected result: score near 400 with oval progress at or above 0.95. The Integrator's controller is the only variable I expect to move bend excursions. A lead change to y 0.04 or a 16 mm footprint at 50 mm remain untested options for later iterations, and I will propose one only if the Integrator's controller is stable on this base.
